audience: recruiters and HR teams that look up candidates, companies and vacancies in their own Carerix tenant

useCases.title: Review the vacancies in your tenant
useCases.text: Read a page of vacancies from your Carerix tenant and summarize the roles for a hiring manager. Up to 100 records per page.

useCases.title: Look up candidates in your tenant
useCases.text: Read a page of candidate records from your Carerix tenant and summarize them for a recruiter. No mailbox data is read.

useCases.title: Find the client companies for a role
useCases.text: Read pages of company records from your Carerix tenant and list the companies that match the role you describe.

useCases.title: Match candidates with vacancies
useCases.text: Read candidates and vacancies from your Carerix tenant and suggest which candidates fit which roles.
